actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The drider's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .CAxSzHWizrafT033]]{dancing lights} 1/day each: [[/item .S7VbUetIfVT7B6Eq]]{darkness}, [[/item .nqBDWkVOfcGZt4YU]]{faerie fire}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three attacks, either with its [[/item .xqwxVn28J0zx8Y7H]]{longsword} or its [[/item .3XAtYmmaED1rxaaE]]{longbow}. It can replace one of those attacks with a [[/item .rUvv8Vnh7XbqbCLd]]{bite} attack.

actions.name: longsword
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], or [[/damage average attackMode=twoHanded]] damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: fey ancestry
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against being &reference[charmed apply=false], and magic can't put the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to sleep.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
